  printf '%s\n' '# BEGIN ANTRIEB SSH CLUSTER'
  printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS"
  printf '%s\n' '# END ANTRIEB SSH CLUSTER'
} >> "$hosts_tmp"
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$hosts_tmp" /etc/hosts
rm -f "$hosts_tmp"
printf 'configured %s uid=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$(id -u clusterops)"
